leadText:
This is the second special chapter of the I Can't Choose, Eevee manga. It was first published on Poké Times on January 21, 2025 at 8:01 PM JST. It is 8 pages long.

This is one of three possible endings to the manga. It would've been the final chapter if the fourth chapter had garnered more reposts than the second and third chapters.
